name: ALF transcription elongation factor 2

function.text: AFF2 encodes AF4/FMR2 family member 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and G-quadruplex RNA binding. It participates in DNA-templated transcription elongation and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability (x-linked); FRAXE intellectual disability (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
